2.t: By the Scripture that makes things clear,

3.t: truly We sent it down on a blessed night––We have always sent warnings––

4.t: a night when every matter of wisdom was made distinct

5.t: at Our command––We have always sent messages to man––

6.t: as a mercy [Prophet] from your Lord who sees and knows all,

7.t: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between––if only you people were firm believers––

8.t: there is no god but Him: He gives life and death––He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers––

9.t: yet in [their state of] doubt they take nothing seriously.

10.t: [Prophet], watch out for the Day when the sky brings forth clouds of smoke for all to see.

11.t: It will envelop the people. They will cry, ‘This is a terrible torment!

12.t: Lord relieve us from this torment! We believe!’

13.t: How will this [sudden] faith benefit them? When a prophet came to warn them plainly,

14.t: they turned their backs on him, saying, ‘He is tutored! He is possessed!’

15.t: We shall hold the torment back for a while ––you are sure to return [to Us]––

16.t: and on the Day We seize [them] mightily We shall exact retribution.

17.t: We tested the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them,

18.t: saying, ‘Hand the servants of God over to me! I am a faithful messenger who has been sent to you.

19.t: Do not consider yourselves to be above God! I come to you with clear authority.

20.t: I seek refuge in my Lord and yours against your insults!

21.t: If you do not believe me, just let me be.’

22.t: [Moses] cried to his Lord, ‘These people are evildoers!’

23.t: [God replied], ‘Escape in the night with My servants, for you are sure to be pursued.

24.t: Leave the sea behind you parted and their army will be drowned.’

25.t: Many a garden and spring they left behind,

26.t: many a cornfield and noble building,

27.t: many a thing in which they had delighted:

28.t: We gave these to another people to inherit.

29.t: Neither heavens nor earth shed a tear for them, nor were they given any time.

30.t: We saved the Children of Israel from their degrading suffering

31.t: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds.

32.t: We chose them knowingly above others:

33.t: We gave them revelations in which there was a clear test.

35.t: ‘There is nothing beyond our one death: we will not be resurrected.

36.t: Bring back our forefathers, if what you say is true.’

37.t: Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who flourished before them? We destroyed them all- they were guilty.

38.t: We were not playing a pointless game when We created the heavens and earth and everything in between;

39.t: We created them for a true purpose, but most people do not comprehend.

40.t: The Day of Decision is the time appointed for all;

41.t: a Day when no friend can take another’s place.

42.t: No one will receive any help except for those to whom God shows mercy: He is the Mighty, the Merciful Lord.

44.t: will be food for the sinners:

45.t: [hot] as molten metal, it boils in their bellies

47.t: ‘Take him! Thrust him into the depths of Hell!

48.t: Pour scalding water over his head as punishment!’

51.t: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place

53.t: clothed in silk and fine brocade, facing one another:

54.t: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes.

55.t: Secure and contented, they will call for every kind of fruit.

56.t: After the one death they will taste death no more. God will guard them from the torment of Hell,

57.t: a bounty from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

58.t: We have made this Quran easy to understand- in your own language [Prophet]- so that they may take heed.

59.t: So wait; the disbelievers too are waiting.
